report_label: M5 badge vocabulary and explanation drawers

entries.label: Official
entries.summary: First-party build, signed and attested by the release identity.
entries.explanation_drawer: This artifact is published by the project's own release identity and carries a verified first-party signature. It is the only origin that can carry an unqualified Stable claim.

entries.label: Vendor
entries.summary: Authored by a governed vendor or partner.
entries.explanation_drawer: A known vendor or partner authored this under a governed agreement. The origin is accountable but is not first-party, so a claim built on it narrows below Stable until first-party evidence is present.

entries.label: Community
entries.summary: Community-contributed and reviewed, not first-party.
entries.explanation_drawer: The community contributed and reviewed this artifact. It is legitimate but not first-party, so a claim built on it narrows below Stable.

entries.label: Mirrored
entries.summary: Served from a mirror of a first-party artifact.
entries.explanation_drawer: This came from a mirror copy rather than the first-party channel. The mirror's freshness stays inspectable without reaching vendor services, but a mirrored origin narrows the claim until first-party provenance is confirmed.

entries.label: Offline bundle
entries.summary: Installed from an offline bundle; origin recorded, not live-verified.
entries.explanation_drawer: This was installed from an offline bundle. Its origin is recorded but not live-verified against the channel, so the claim narrows until the origin can be reverified online.

entries.label: Side-loaded
entries.summary: Installed outside the governed channel.
entries.explanation_drawer: This was side-loaded outside the governed channel. The origin is shown rather than hidden, but a side-loaded artifact cannot carry a Stable claim until it is reconciled with the governed channel.

entries.label: Not provided
entries.summary: Origin evidence was not provided.
entries.explanation_drawer: No origin evidence was provided for this artifact. A missing origin is recorded explicitly — never left blank — and blocks any Stable claim until provenance is supplied.

entries.label: Signature verified
entries.summary: Signature and attestation verified against the release identity.
entries.explanation_drawer: The artifact's signature was checked against the release identity and a build attestation is present and valid. This is the strongest signature state.

entries.label: Signature unverified
entries.summary: A signature is present but could not be verified.
entries.explanation_drawer: A signature is present but could not be verified against a trusted key in the current context. The claim narrows until the signature verifies.

entries.label: Attestation available
entries.summary: A build attestation is available.
entries.explanation_drawer: A build attestation is available describing how this artifact was produced. Attestation is positive evidence but does not by itself substitute for a verified signature.

entries.label: Unsigned
entries.summary: No signature is present.
entries.explanation_drawer: This artifact carries no signature. An unsigned artifact narrows the claim until signing evidence is added.

entries.label: Signature invalid
entries.summary: A signature is present but failed verification.
entries.explanation_drawer: A signature is present but failed verification — the bytes do not match the claimed identity. An invalid signature blocks any Stable claim and is surfaced rather than ignored.

entries.label: Signature not provided
entries.summary: No signature evidence was provided.
entries.explanation_drawer: No signature evidence was provided for this artifact. The absence is recorded explicitly and narrows the claim until signature state is supplied.

entries.label: Evidence current
entries.summary: Evidence is within its freshness window.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence behind this claim is within its freshness window. The claim stands at its full class.

entries.label: Evidence aging
entries.summary: Evidence has fallen outside its freshness window.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence has fallen outside its freshness window. Stale evidence automatically narrows the claim below Stable until it is refreshed.

entries.label: Evidence expired
entries.summary: Evidence has passed its hard expiry.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence has passed its hard expiry. Expired evidence blocks a Stable claim until it is renewed.

entries.label: Evidence missing
entries.summary: No usable evidence exists.
entries.explanation_drawer: No usable evidence exists for this claim. A missing-evidence state blocks a Stable claim and is recorded explicitly rather than omitted.

entries.label: Complete
entries.summary: Evidence covers the full claimed scope.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence covers the full claimed scope. Nothing in the claimed matrix is left unverified.

entries.label: Limited evidence
entries.summary: Evidence covers a narrower scope than claimed.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence covers a narrower scope than the claim. The claim narrows to what the evidence actually supports.

entries.label: Partial
entries.summary: Only part of the claimed scope is evidenced.
entries.explanation_drawer: Only part of the claimed scope is backed by evidence. The unverified remainder is named rather than implied, and the claim narrows accordingly.

entries.label: Retest pending
entries.summary: Evidence is awaiting re-verification.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence is awaiting re-verification — a retest is queued or in progress. The claim narrows until the retest completes.

entries.label: Evidence stale
entries.summary: The evidence body itself has aged out.
entries.explanation_drawer: The evidence body itself has aged past its freshness window. A stale evidence body narrows the claim below Stable until it is refreshed.

entries.label: Evidence not provided
entries.summary: No evidence body was provided.
entries.explanation_drawer: No evidence body was provided for this claim. The absence is recorded explicitly and blocks a Stable claim until evidence is supplied.

entries.label: Certified
entries.summary: Certified against current reference evidence.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface is certified against current reference evidence — the strongest support claim. Certification narrows automatically if its evidence goes stale or missing.

entries.label: Supported
entries.summary: Supported by current evidence.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface is supported by current evidence under a defined support window. It is a full claim short of formal certification.

entries.label: Limited
entries.summary: Supported with narrower guarantees.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface is supported only with narrower guarantees than a full claim. The reduced scope is stated rather than implied, and the claim narrows accordingly.

entries.label: Community
entries.summary: Community-maintained support only.
entries.explanation_drawer: Support for this surface is community-maintained rather than first-party. It is a legitimate but narrower support class, so the claim narrows below a first-party class.

entries.label: Experimental
entries.summary: Experimental, behind an explicit gate.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface is experimental and sits behind an explicit gate. Experimental support narrows the claim well below Stable.

entries.label: Unsupported
entries.summary: Not supported by current evidence.
entries.explanation_drawer: Current evidence does not support this surface. An unsupported state blocks a Stable claim and is surfaced rather than hidden.

entries.label: Desktop (full)
entries.summary: Full desktop surface with full authority.
entries.explanation_drawer: The full desktop product surface. Only this client scope carries full authority and capability parity.

entries.label: Companion (scoped)
entries.summary: Companion surface with bounded, host-relayed scope.
entries.explanation_drawer: A companion surface with bounded scope relayed through the desktop host. It narrows a claim so it can never imply the desktop's authority or capability parity.

entries.label: Mobile companion
entries.summary: Mobile companion surface.
entries.explanation_drawer: A mobile companion surface with bounded scope. It narrows a claim and cannot imply desktop parity.

entries.label: Embedded panel
entries.summary: Panel embedded inside another surface.
entries.explanation_drawer: A panel hosted inside another surface, under the host's constraints. It narrows a claim and cannot imply full-surface authority.

entries.label: Browser reference
entries.summary: Read-only browser reference surface.
entries.explanation_drawer: A browser reference surface — read-only and informational. It narrows a claim to discovery or reference and cannot carry in-product authority.

entries.label: Handoff only
entries.summary: Only creates or opens a desktop handoff.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface can only create or open a desktop handoff. It narrows a claim to handoff actions and carries no standalone authority.

entries.label: Full authority
entries.summary: Carries full authority and capability parity.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface carries full authority — the actions it offers are authoritative and at parity with the desktop.

entries.label: Scoped authority
entries.summary: Authority bounded to a relayed scope.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface's authority is bounded to a relayed scope. It narrows a claim and cannot widen to desktop authority.

entries.label: Reference only
entries.summary: Informational; carries no authority.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface is reference-only — it shows information but carries no authority to act. The claim narrows to reference.

entries.label: Handoff authority
entries.summary: Authority limited to creating a handoff.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface's authority is limited to creating a desktop handoff. It narrows a claim and never acts authoritatively on its own.

entries.label: Authority not provided
entries.summary: Authority class was not provided.
entries.explanation_drawer: No authority class was provided for this surface. The absence is recorded explicitly and blocks a Stable claim until it is supplied.

entries.label: No handoff required
entries.summary: Acts in place with no handoff.
entries.explanation_drawer: This surface acts in place and requires no handoff to another client. This is the only handoff state that does not narrow on handoff grounds.

entries.label: Desktop handoff required
entries.summary: Privileged actions require a desktop handoff.
entries.explanation_drawer: Privileged actions on this surface require handing off to the desktop. The requirement is named rather than failing silently, and it narrows the surface's standalone claim.

entries.label: Console handoff required
entries.summary: Privileged actions require a vendor console handoff.
entries.explanation_drawer: Privileged actions here require handing off to a vendor console. The requirement is named explicitly and narrows the surface's standalone claim.

entries.label: Handoff state not provided
entries.summary: Handoff requirement was not provided.
entries.explanation_drawer: No handoff requirement was provided for this surface. The absence is recorded explicitly and blocks a Stable claim until it is supplied.
